main_text.head: JOANNES HENRICUS HEIDEGGERUS Anagr: NICANDER è HOHENEGG VIR SS. JESU.
EPIGRAMMA.
main_text.p: PApicolas vincit, debellat, profligat, ecce, Nicander, celsa stirpe locóque satus ; Vir Salvatoris JESU Sanctíque Sacrique, Et Domini Servus fidus & eximius. Nicander sine fine vire, Christíque fideles Defende, & JESU Vir famulúsque mane.

page.notes: The large initial P is set as a woodcut-style letter and joined to "Apicolas" as printed; the word "Apicolas" is probably a printing form of the Latin name as set. The line "Nicander sine fine vire" and the signature are as printed. Faint show-through from the reverse side is not transcribed.
